categories.main_business_segments: CL Holdings operates primarily in the marketing services sector, offering a single business segment focused on providing marketing support services to corporate clients. The group includes several consolidated subsidiaries, with key activities spanning promotional services, merchandising, location-based entertainment, and themed cafes.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages expertise in campaign planning, merchandising, OEM production, and themed entertainment experiences, often utilizing licensed IP content. Production is largely fabless, with manufacturing and logistics outsourced to partner companies, while quality and production management are ensured through ISO9001-certified processes and dedicated quality control subsidiaries in China.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major corporations, especially in the consumer goods, retail, and entertainment industries. Notable end markets include beverage manufacturers, retailers, and entertainment content holders, with Nintendo highlighted as a significant client in the latest fiscal year.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are centered in Japan, with additional group companies and activities in China (Shanghai and Shenzhen), and some presence in other Asian markets. The majority of revenue and assets are Japan-based, but the group is actively expanding services leveraging Japanese IP content in Asian markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: CL Holdings operates midstream and downstream in the supply chain, acting as a marketing service provider, campaign planner, and merchandise distributor. The company does not own manufacturing facilities but coordinates production and logistics through external partners.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include maximizing group synergies, optimizing the business portfolio, expanding into new business areas (such as themed cafes and overseas markets), and investing in digital transformation (DX) for both customer and employee experience. Sustainability, human capital development, and M&A for synergistic growth are also emphasized. There is no significant in-house R&D activity reported.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through project-based sales of marketing services, merchandise, OEM production, and themed entertainment experiences. Additional income streams include BPO services, licensing, and limited-time/location-based retail events.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include large advertising agencies and marketing service providers such as Dentsu Group and Hakuhodo DY Holdings, as well as specialized merchandising and promotional firms. CL Holdings positions itself as a leading provider of integrated marketing and entertainment experience solutions, with a unique focus on IP-driven experiential marketing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending December 2024, consolidated revenue was approximately 38.3 billion yen, with 623 employees. While revenue grew 5.3% year-on-year, operating profit declined sharply due to increased costs and one-off expenses, and net profit attributable to owners fell by 67.8%. The company is in a phase of portfolio optimization and restructuring to restore profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CL Holdings differentiates itself by combining marketing expertise with entertainment and experiential value, creating new markets at the intersection of promotion, merchandising, and themed entertainment. The company leverages strong relationships with IP holders and delivers high-value, immersive consumer experiences, supported by robust quality management and group synergies.
